target: original top-logit family, fixed before interventions
ranking: direct family evidence attention, mean over heads
intervention: zero token identity only; hold numeric values, context, masks, graph edges and cross-branch duplicates fixed
limitations: Signature attention does not pass this token-identity faithfulness diagnostic: top beats random on only one of five samples, with negative mean difference.
Small differences in other groups on five clustered samples do not establish faithfulness or statistical significance.
Graph rankings cover 128 of 1024 encoded nodes for all five samples, not the full graph.
One sample has just one static token; top and random deletion are necessarily identical there.
This is not whole-event or whole-evidence deletion, rollout, an independent benchmark, calibrated probability analysis or causal proof.
